name: personal_commit
description: Preview, create, or amend a Conventional Commit from separate subject and causal body fields. Does not stage or push.

body.description: why the change exists, not who asked for it

repo.description: repository to commit in; relative paths resolve against the session directory, and the default is the session repository

name: vault
description: Log in to websites, APIs and command-line tools with the passwords, API keys, tokens and TOTP codes stored in your Bitwarden vaults, without seeing them: `private` (personal and university accounts, such as aau.at) and `scch` (SCCH accounts, reachable only on the SCCH network or FortiClient VPN). Use it whenever a sign-in page, a password prompt or a missing token blocks work, before asking the person. search returns entry names, ids, usernames, URIs and field names, not secrets. file delivers one field to a private file and returns its path after entry approval. Use the path without printing or reading the value into the conversation: --passwordfile PATH, $(cat PATH) inside a command, curl -H @PATH for header files, or a dotenv loader for dotenv files. For browser sign-in, use `await tab.fill(selector, (await Bun.file(PATH).text()))` in a JavaScript eval cell. Delivered secrets are redacted to [vault:...] labels in outputs. Usernames stay readable. Files and unlocks expire at local midnight. lock ends access early and deletes files. If a path is missing or expired, call file again for the same entry and field and use the new path. Request a fresh totp file immediately before use because the code expires sooner.

query.description: search: words in the entry name

field.description: file: username, password, totp, notes or a custom field name

format.description: file: raw value (default), NAME=value line or Name: value line

name.description: file: variable or header name for dotenv and header formats

purpose.description: file: what the value is for, shown to the person when approving
